name: number_partitioning_k3_n21_seed64697__v4_nh
prompt:
Partition the integers {1, 2, ..., 21} into 3 disjoint subsets, each summing to the same value 77. (The total sum is 21*(21+1)/2 = 231, so the target is 231/3 = 77.) NP-hard partition problem.

Return a flat list of 21 integers in {0, ..., 2} where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the subset assignment of integer i+1. State "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such partition exists.
